what: decision 141, the music loops of the app's pack as the app plays them, asked a second time with a prompt that does not name a skip (free, no call that makes sound). The first prompt (r46) asked whether anything stumbles, skips or jumps, and the listener named a skip in all 12 clips, the four controls with no seam in them included: that prompt is no test. The clips are the same files as in r46. open-seam-<season>: 16 s of the packed loop played round with the app's cross of one bar (2.4 s), the cross from 7.0 to 9.4 s of the clip. open-plain-<season>: the control, 16 s of the same loop with no seam in it. Two listenings of each seam clip, one of each control. The rule of counting, fixed before the answers were read: a fault at the seam is a skip, stutter, jump, cut, doubling, overlap, repeat or sudden change that answer 1 or 2 places between 6 and 10.5 s of a seam clip; the same named elsewhere or in a control is written down and is not the seam. The seam is told apart only if such faults come at the seam's place in the seam clips more often than faults of the same kind come in the controls.
